loops.name: L1 Splat loop
loops.evidence: Cycles render of X3D master -> gsplat -> x3d-blender-io export with slabs -> fork + upstream validators -> X_ITE vs numpy oracle vs Blender mesh/5.3 native -> PSNR split synthetic/real, size by SH degree -> fixes into exporter, validator and compact-encoding rules.

loops.name: L2 Importer/exporter defect loop
loops.evidence: Library corpus (585 on-disk, Tier A 111) + spine mutants -> round-trip ledger -> value-level defects (colour, defaults, crashes) -> Blenderization fixes -> better Hall renders and calibration -> sharper fixtures.

loops.name: L3 Tether/guard loop
loops.evidence: Blender agent script -> loss audit -> export -> pinned validator -> X_ITE + Blender render -> ledger step -> failures become loss-audit rules, lints and ladder rungs, which gate the next agent script.

loops.name: L6 Provenance/Library loop
